# The person asks to redo section 2 with a note. Only section 2 runs again, as generation 2, and then the abstract runs again.
# Section 1 keeps its generation 1. The second draft is approved and published once, with the revised section 2.
[!exec:jq] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

rdinit
rdfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env RESEARCH_DESK_DIR=$WORK/rd
env RESEARCH_HOME=$WORK/store
env SEARCH_API=http://search.test
env WIKI_API=http://wiki.test
env RESEARCH_HEADER_FILE=$WORK/home/.research/credential.header

exec obeereal item add research-desk cold-cost --title 'Cold and cost' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star &

waitstatus 'paused: Review the draft report of cold-cost, round 1'
exec obeereal answer cold-cost redo 2: state the price per month
waitstatus 'paused: Review the draft report of cold-cost, round 2'
exec obeereal answer cold-cost approve
wait
stdout 'item cold-cost finished'

cmp calls.log expected-calls.log
grep 'state the price per month' store/cold-cost/s2.2/note
! exists store/cold-cost/s1.2
grep -count=1 'Revised per the note' wiki.page
grep -count=1 'The unit costs 12 euro per month. Revised per the note' wiki.page
! grep 'Cold cut the output by 30 percent. Revised' wiki.page
grep -count=1 '^cold-cost-' wiki.log

-- body.txt --
How does the cold change the output of a unit, and what does it cost?
-- expected-calls.log --
plan
read cold
judge
write Output
read cost
judge
write Cost
abstract
read cost
judge
write Cost
abstract
-- home/.research/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_search --
{"results":[{"url":"http://pages.test/page/a"},{"url":"http://pages.test/page/b"}]}
-- resp/_page_a --
<p>Winter tests. At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent.</p>
-- resp/_page_b --
<p>The unit costs 12 euro per month.</p>
